text:
Tara (PM): Heads-up thread: we need a compact launch-ready spec for Reserved Pools + quotas. Sales wants firm language on burst guarantees + fallback ladder for pilot terms. Need engineering input on workable defaults.

Omar (Eng-Platform): From infra POV: minimal shipping surface = allocation API, token-bucket burst ledger, simple fallback order, and per-tenant headroom metric. Avoid per-route knobs for MVP.

Pri (Customer Success): Pilots asked for two things: (1) an explicit fallback ladder that prefers degraded-quality vs queued waits, (2) visible console indicators when fallback is active. They hate silent substitutions.

Wei (Eng-SRE): Fallback ladder options we discussed: A) quantized same-model variant, B) smaller-architecture model, C) short best-effort queue. For MVP I recommend ordering: A -> B -> C with queue cap 120ms. Also require request trace tags: fallback.active + fallback.reason.

Tara (PM): Good. What about autoscale bounds? We need something that ties to customer commitment but is simple to document.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Suggest mapping: replicas = base_replicas * commitment_tier_multiplier. Base_replicas computed from committed throughput. For defaults: min_replicas = 2, max_replicas = commit_base * 3, burst_window_s = 300, queue_ms = 120, fallback_on_saturation = route_quantized.

Pri (Customer Success): Contract language will need to call out expected quality delta when routed to quantized variant. Legal wants opt-out clause. Also pilots want an "escalate to CS" button on fallback banner.

Rohit (Legal): We can draft fallback clause that states: "In saturation events Redwood may route requests to a lower-fidelity model or queued best-effort handling; customers will be notified and may opt-out of automatic downgrades for specific routes." I'll draft a conservative version.

Wei (Eng-SRE): Alerting: add burst_credit_depleted (S1 for pilots), fallback.active_long (>2m) -> email + page for assigned owner, and headroom_pct_drop (>30% drop) -> slack alert. Also add chaos test in preprod: simulate sustained 6m burst + preemption.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Implementation note: token-bucket carryover: allow up to 10% carryover for unused credits. Helps smooth daily patterns without big complexity.

Tara (PM): Ok prioritization — MUST: allocation API, token-bucket ledger, fallback routing, telemetry (headroom_pct, fallback.count), legal fallback clause draft. SHOULD: console banner + email notifications, pilot onboarding doc. MAYBE: self-serve quota edits, per-route opt-outs in UI.

Pri (Customer Success): Pilots will push console banner to MUST but we can try SHOULD and escalate.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Rollout plan: internal canary 1% -> pilot tenants 10% -> pilot expansion. Gate to move to each stage: no regressions in p95 tail, fallback rate <2% of reserved requests, and pilot CS sign-off.

Tara (PM): Deliverables: Omar/Wei PR with autoscale defaults + telemetry schema by Thu, Rohit to share contract blurb by Thu, Pri to gather pilot redlines by Fri. ci-bot create ticket?

ci-bot: Ticket PROD-1650 created: "Reserved pools MVP spec + fallback ladder" assigned to Omar, Wei, Rohit, Pri. Due 1713410000. :white_check_mark:

Wei (Eng-SRE): One more detail: ensure we log fallback.reason with model_variant and latency impact so we can produce post-mortem grade reports for customers.

Omar (Eng-Platform): Will do. Also adding a small sample autoscale JSON to PR for docs.

Tara (PM): Quick thumbs check: :thumbsup: if you agree with MUST/SHOULD split, :eyes: if you want to discuss.

Omar (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:

Pri (Customer Success): :eyes: I may push banner to MUST for Pilot A.

Wei (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup:

Rohit (Legal): :thumbsup:

Tara (PM): Thanks. 15m sync tomorrow 11:15 to confirm PR link and banner decision.
